ErrorCode.description:
Why a run failed. New codes are additive; non-Python readers (the pane) must treat an
unknown code as a generic failure.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

RunError.description: The error attached to a ``failed`` status.

message.description: One or two sentences: what failed and what to do next.
message.title: Message

log_tail.description: The last part of log.txt (at most Limits.log_tail_bytes).
log_tail.title: Log Tail

RunError.title: RunError

RunState.description:
Lifecycle state of a run. ``status.json`` is authoritative; ``index.json`` caches it.
``paused``: a live run waiting at a communication point (ADR 0010).
RunState.title: RunState

description:
``runs/<id>/status.json``: the authoritative state. Single writer at a time: the server
writes ``queued``; the worker owns the file while it lives; the server writes a terminal
state only after it has confirmed the worker is gone (ADR 0002, ADR 0007).

heartbeat_at.description: Written by the worker's heartbeat thread, independent of t.
heartbeat_at.title: Heartbeat At

pid.description: Worker pid; also its process group id.
pid.title: Pid

pid_start_time.description: Field 22 of /proc/<pid>/stat (clock ticks since boot); guards pid reuse.
pid_start_time.title: Pid Start Time

last_cmd.description: Live runs: the ID of the last inbox command that got an outcome (a display field; outcomes/<id>.json is the record).
last_cmd.title: Last Cmd

heartbeat_mono.description: The worker's time.monotonic() (CLOCK_MONOTONIC, shared by the processes of one machine and blind to wall-clock jumps) when it wrote heartbeat_at. Staleness uses it; files without it fall back to heartbeat_at.
heartbeat_mono.title: Heartbeat Mono

speed.description: Live runs: the pacing factor (1 = real time); null for batch runs.
speed.title: Speed

reason.description: Why a run ended where its state alone doesn't say: the live idle limit, or an FMU that ended the run before t_stop. Null otherwise.
reason.title: Reason

title: RunStatus
